issues.description: Element: initial pixel value load and the printf argument sequence. Problem statement (problem_statement.md) explicitly instructs that the computed pixel memory value must be loaded into ECX using 'mov ecx, [esi]' before the printf call so that the printf argument order 'push ecx; push ebx; push eax; push message' supplies (value, y, x). The template (template_repository/pixel.asm) expects ECX to hold the pixel value when it does 'push ecx; push ebx; push eax; push message' (lines 112-116). The solution implementation (solution_repository/pixel.asm) instead performs 'mov eax, [esi]' (line 101) and does not set ECX, so the value pushed as the first argument to printf is undefined/wrong. This mismatch between the problem specification/template and the solution confuses students about which register must contain the pixel value and leads to incorrect printed output.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution consistent with the problem and template by loading the pixel value into ECX before preparing printf arguments. Replace 'mov eax, [esi]' with 'mov ecx, [esi]' (and adjust any use of EAX accordingly, preserving EAX if needed with push/pop). Alternatively, if keeping 'mov eax, [esi]', change the printf argument pushes to 'push eax; push ebx; push eax_saved_or_x; push message' and ensure registers are saved/restored so the printed value, y and x are passed in the order expected by the template/problem.
